# Remontvision (ремонтвижн)

> AI-сервис редизайна интерьера по фото: генерация визуализации, подбор материалов и товаров, смета, RAL, электрика, точечные правки, кабинет, публичный шаринг и админка.

Repo: https://github.com/oblacko/remontvision (private)  
Prod: https://www.remontvision.ru  
Last updated: 2026-10-29

## Current state (2026-10-28)

- Generation: FLUX 3 Image, 1K, aspect auto; cleanup FLUX 3 Image Klein; vision Gemini 3 Flash.
- Room cleanup: FLUX 3 Image Klein, 1K, auto; enabled by default, applied only when `keep_furniture=false`.
- 10 styles, 12 room types, 100 active demo products, **0 products with real URL**.
- 120 style references, 26 approved (pilot 5 styles × 6 rooms).
- Prompt rules editable in admin (`app_settings.prompt.rules.v1`).
- Catalog import by URL and bulk list; drafts only, manual activation.
- Order links use `/go/:productId?r=renderId`; demo products fall back to search.
- Share page `/s/:token` with likes/comments.
- Payments on (Robokassa default, YooKassa fallback), refunds off. Robokassa sends fiscal `Receipt` (service, tax none) for Roboчеки СМЗ.
- Product procurement on: 1 credit per render, Yandex Search API + store allowlist, product list only (no estimate/quantities).
- Main launch blocker: no real product URLs → no real orders.

## Architecture (short)

- Node 20 + Express + PostgreSQL 16 + worker in `src/jobs.js`.
- React/Vite frontend in `web/`.
- Nginx + Let's Encrypt; apex → 301 → www.
- OpenRouter for image + vision; optional proxy for WAF.
- Storage: disk or S3.
- Deploy: push `main` → GitHub Actions → VPS Docker Compose + smoke.

## Generation flow (short)

1. `POST /api/rooms` with photo, room type, style or reference, tier, flags.
2. Credit + `render(status=queued)`.
3. Worker: room/style/tier → one art ref → curate products → text-only material constraints → cleanup when furniture off → design without product refs → vision → estimate.
4. `render_items` have `curated|matched|verified` statuses; unverified products are not claimed as exact matches.
5. Product edit: parent + one target/product ref → mandatory vision QA → `done|rejected`; rejection restores the credit and keeps the parent active.
6. Share/links: `/s/:token`, `/go/:id`.

## Key files

- `src/server.js` — HTTP API/auth/admin/share/payments.
- `src/jobs.js` — worker.
- `src/openrouter.js` — provider, prompt, vision, matching.
- `src/promptconfig.js` — prompt defaults/config.
- `src/roomtypes.js` — room slots/keep/change/styling.
- `src/curate.js` — product selection + refs.
- `src/productimport.js` — URL import.
- `src/modelcaps.js` — model capabilities.
- `src/payments.js`, `src/robokassa.js` — credits, Robokassa/YooKassa, refunds.
- `src/procurement.js`, `src/yandexsearch.js`, `src/procurementtemplates.js` — product search by render.
- `src/db.js` + `migrations/` — data.
- `web/src/components/GenerationPanel.tsx` — generator UI.
- `web/src/pages/Admin.tsx`, `Cabinet.tsx`, `Share.tsx`.

## Commands

```bash
npm install
npm test                 # 39 tests
npm start                # Node >=20.6, --env-file
cd web && npm run build  # tsc + vite
docker compose up -d db  # local Postgres 127.0.0.1:5434
```

## Constraints / gotchas

- `.env` secrets are not committed.
- DB env is `RV_DATABASE_URL`, not `DATABASE_URL`.
- FLUX.2 Pro does not accept `resolution`; may be blocked by content moderation.
- Seedream/FLUX are image-only: do not use chat fallback.
- Demo catalog has no real URLs; do not claim real checkout works.
- Design-first product binding exists; no automatic 2–4 design variants or inpainting yet.
- No automated backups/metrics yet.
- `db.js` exits without `RV_DATABASE_URL`; avoid importing it in unit tests.

## Next priorities

1. Import 20–50 real products with URLs for one style/room.
2. Build a style kit from real products, re-generate hero refs.
3. Validate `/go` and real order links.
4. Add automatic design variants with explicit selection and billing, plus inpainting.
5. Add feeds/CPA, price/availability sync, backups/monitoring.
